situation (example wording): "Texas carjackings in 2025", "Texas carjackings 2015 to 2025" (a Part I offense for a state keeps P53's Crime Index figures), "national carjackings 2019 to 2025", "Texas carjacking rate in 2025", "Texas murder clearance by type in 2025"
what the app does today: A state or national NIBRS sum (P61) is one answer for any span: every month any agency reported, with the disclaimer and a button for the Consistent Reporting Agencies. Clearance, a breakdown or a rate for a state, the nation or several agencies is mostly declined ("This isn't available: ...").
proposed behavior: A count or a sum over agencies is allowed for a state, the nation or several agencies, with this default. ONE year: the sum of every agency that reported, with the coverage line (how many agencies are in and out, and their share of the population). SEVERAL years (or months across years, or no period named): answered straight away the same way, every agency that reported, with the note and a button for the Consistent Reporting Agencies (the agencies that reported every month asked: only a month with crimes reported counts, a zero report does not, P121), as P61, P03 and P88 say. No ask (Jeff 2026-11-22: "Answer, with a button"; the several-years ask first decided here on 2026-11-21 is withdrawn). A rate is the same sum per 100,000 people in the agencies counted (P62). Applies to NIBRS-sourced figures only: Current Trends keeps P91 and P155, a Part I offense for a state or the nation keeps P53, several named agencies combined keep P58. Exceptions are a written list with a reason each (for example staffing, P98; a rate for a group of people, which needs population by race, sex or age).
exact default or choices offered: No question for one year or several: all reporting agencies, with the note and the "Consistent Reporting Agencies" button (P80 label and explanation).
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (typed, through the coordinator): "All reporting agencies for a single year; across multiple years it should ask whether the user wants all agencies or just consistent reporting agencies." Changes P61 (several years asks first, one year unchanged), P62 (the same split) and the state and national kind of P81; P57's state and national clearance sentence follows the same split. P80, P91, P155, P53 and P58 unchanged.
status: Decided 2026-11-21 (Jeff, through the coordinator); the several-years ask withdrawn 2026-11-22 (Jeff: "Answer, with a button")
test cases: Not built: tests come with the build.
